test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which ministry is established with a mission of development, education and research in the field of alternative medicine?

options.text: The Ministry of Environment, Forests and Climate Change
The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
The Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Ministry of AYUSH**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ministry of Ayush is responsible for the development, education, and research of alternative medicine in India.
 
• The Ministry of Ayush has conducted research and has signed agreements with the World Health Organization (WHO) to strengthen traditional medicine systems. 
 
• The Ministry has made efforts to ensure that new medical colleges comply with guidelines and to reduce the number of substandard colleges. 
 
• The Ministry has worked to develop healthcare infrastructure, promote exports, and reform education.
 
• The Ministry has initiated efforts to collect morbidity statistics for various systems of medicine, including Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **The Ministry of Environment, Forests and Climate Change**:

 
 
• This ministry is responsible for the planning, promotion, and coordination of environmental and forestry policies, including climate change adaptation.
 
• It oversees the protection of wildlife, forests, and biodiversity in India.
 
 
 
• **The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare**:
 
 
• This ministry manages national health policies and oversees public health, medical services, and family welfare programs.
 
• It is focused on improving healthcare infrastructure, disease control, and maternal and child health in India.
 
 
 
• **The Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare**:
 
 
• This ministry formulates agricultural policies to improve farmer livelihoods, enhance productivity, and ensure food security.
 
 
• It provides support for agricultural development, research, and the promotion of sustainable farming practices.
